The '''Zipthar Hexa-crystals''' were a type of rare and valuable [[Crystal/Legends|crystals]] mined in the [[Zipthar system/Legends|Zipthar system]].

These shimmering, round crystals were formed in a prism-like lattice that bend and reflected light in unusual ways.

==History==
During the height of the [[New Order/Legends|New Order]], Zipthar hexa-crystals were considered rare in the [[Velcar Free Commerce Zone]] which strictly controlled all exports. Many [[Smuggler/Legends|smugglers]] made small fortunes transporting them to various individuals.

In the years following the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]], smugglers [[Reina Gale]] and [[Rollos]] went to [[Entralla/Legends|Entralla]] in order to sell crystals to [[Begas Tok]]. The deal was interrupted by the intervention of the [[Pentastar Patrol]].
